# SEC-003: Platform SSH key folder is closed to other users

- **Group:** Secrets on disk
- **Severity when it fails:** critical
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

The platform keeps the private SSH keys of every server it manages in one folder, usually for root logins. Anyone who can read it owns every managed server.

## Verify by hand

```sh
stat -c '%a %U:%G' /data/coolify/ssh/keys; ls -l /data/coolify/ssh/keys
```

## How to fix it

chmod 700 the folder and chmod 600 every key in it.

Run `stackward explain SEC-003` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
